tool_input.command: echo "PWD: $(pwd)"; echo "SCHEMA: $MLPAB_DATABRICKS_SCHEMA"; echo "PREFIX: $MLPAB_DATABRICKS_PREFIX"; echo "HOST: $DATABRICKS_HOST"; echo "---DATA---"; ls -la data/; echo "---HEAD---"; head -20 data/training_data.csv; echo "---WC---"; wc -l data/training_data.csv

tool_input.description: Read schema and check databricks CLI

tool_input.command:
echo "---USER---"; databricks current-user me 2>&1 | grep -E '"userName"|"emails"|"displayName"' | head -5
echo "---WAREHOUSES---"; databricks warehouses list 2>&1 | head -20
echo "---SCHEMA exists?---"; databricks schemas get workspace.mlpab4b6179 2>&1 | head -20
tool_input.description: Get user, warehouses, and confirm schema

tool_input.command:
set -e
databricks volumes create workspace mlpab4b6179 data MANAGED 2>&1 | grep -E '"full_name"|error' || echo "volume create done/exists"
echo "---UPLOAD---"
databricks fs cp data/training_data.csv dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab4b6179/data/training_data.csv --overwrite 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "---LIST---"
databricks fs ls dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab4b6179/data/ 2>&1

set -e
W=4dfab06c923fe3cc
databricks api post /api/2.0/sql/statements --json '{
  "warehouse_id": "'$W'",
  "wait_timeout": "50s",
  "statement": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab4b6179.training_data AS SELECT * FROM read_files(\"/Volumes/workspace/mlpab4b6179/data/training_data.csv\", format => \"csv\", header => true, inferSchema => true)"
}' 2>&1 | grep -E '"state"|"message"' | head -5
tool_input.description: Create table from CSV via SQL warehouse
Compute correlation of each feature with label
